relationships.subject: FSGT capsule
relationships.evidence_quote: FSGT capsule decreased the elevated serum contents of rheumatoid factor (RF) and VEGF, and some pro-inflammatory cytokines like TNFα and IL-6.

relationships.subject: FSGT capsule
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, FSGT capsule also reduced the elevated protein expression of ICAM1, IL-1β and phosphorylated protein kinase B (Akt) in synovium from CIA mice.

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Meanwhile, 7 compounds from FSGT decreased the VEGF-induced HUVEC migration.

key_findings: FSGT capsule alleviated arthritis in CIA mice and lowered serum VEGF, TNFα and IL-6.
Six FSGT compounds inhibited both inflammation and angiogenesis in vitro.
